source.warning: The archived legacy README warns of old page/rune misalignment and broken relative paths. Reproduce the source operations on the byte-verified pinned current page_N files, not the old historical results. Source labels page_N map N=17..74 to current LP2-(N-17).

duplicate_audit.public_attempt_inventory: No exact mention of these three pinned source paths among 172 entries or reviewed subclaims in research/public-attempt-inventory.json.
duplicate_audit.experiments_registry: No exact source-path record in data/experiments.json (245 records at freeze).
partial_overlaps: wulfic-keyword-prime-layer-grid: complete 16-keyword x 103 second-stream x four-sign combined grid; its sequential prime and keyword operations overlap some proposed cases here but not the full stepped family
historical-prime-and-ps-keys and lp2-panel-prime-openings: narrower prime sequences/placements and opening checks, not these full-page source grids
wholepage-known-vigenere-keys: two established LP1 keys, not the source's 18 named words or keyed prime generators
wulfic-lfsr-singleton-constraints: same I/A single-rune premise but different generator and constraints
duplicate_audit.counting_rule: Three source scripts contribute three shared grid branches in one record. Settings, signs, offsets and overlapping output streams are not independent ideas. Report each source branch and duplicate-output counts separately.

inputs_and_rules.page_map: Use source page_N actual pinned rune streams after independent length/SHA256 crosscheck against current site text/lp2-(N-17). Preserve source's word separators and source singleton parser per branch; require nonempty exact rune counts before any search.
inputs_and_rules.keyword_only: Old pages21..30 (current LP2-04..13), source 18 parsed keyword labels, three source modes sub/add/beaufort, repeated key from page start. Keep source normalized IoC, all-singleton I/A count and per-page rankings. The optional verified_keys.json branch is not a named keyword and is excluded pending independent key provenance; disclose this exclusion.
inputs_and_rules.prime_stream: Old pages21,22,24,26,27,28,29,30 (current LP2-04,05,07,09,10,11,12,13). Source 81 listed sequential-prime offsets x three key forms x three modes, ordinary and literal-F-skip decoders; plus five nonsequential source generators gp_ext/fib_idx/spiral/gap/rev_gp x three key forms x three modes. Preserve source score_quick, normalized IoC and singleton counts/screens; do not count exact gp_ext=sequential offset0 output twice. Source defines but does not call prime_of_prime or totient_ordered_primes; those are excluded.
inputs_and_rules.keyword_stepped: Old pages28,53,24,39,29,30,34,51,21,33,45 (current LP2-11,36,07,22,12,13,17,34,04,16,28); source 20 literal GP keyword arrays x eight actual generators x offsets0..1000 x three modes. Preserve its hard all-singleton I/A check followed by normalized IoC>1.3. Count invalid/short streams separately. The keyword_add_sequential subgroup partly duplicates combined keyword/prime arithmetic; quantify equivalent output streams instead of claiming those cases as new ideas.

shared_evaluation.scores: Preserve each branch's original score and screen. Also report normalized GP29 IoC and full-output SHA256 for every selected winner; report source HIT counts without calling IoC alone a decryption.
shared_evaluation.selection_control: For each branch, repeat the complete source grid on 49 seeded within-page rune shuffles, keeping page lengths and word-boundary/singleton positions fixed; seed20261023. Compare the best normalized IoC and source HIT count against full-search null maxima. Optimize by precomputing deterministic key streams and applying singleton checks before full IoC; do not reduce the declared source grid or controls after manuscript outcomes.
shared_evaluation.positive_control: Before outcomes, construct a deterministic planted GP29 page with the same source word/singleton positions as one target and a repeated four-symbol plaintext with I/A at all singleton positions. Encrypt it with one declared setting in each of the three branches. Require exact recovery of the planted stream and a source screen hit; label this synthetic arithmetic/detection control, not evidence of English-detection power.
shared_evaluation.source_parity: Independently compare sampled generated key values, decodes, source scores and singleton decisions against the pinned source functions extracted in a temporary checkout. Verify every saved winner with a separate scalar implementation. Original scripts' relocated-path crashes are not negative results.

limits: One set of source-declared words and old page selections, GP29 index arithmetic and source candidate screens. No page translation, no general proof against prime/keyword ciphers, no claim that a high IoC alone reads English. Other prime orderings or source declared but uncalled functions remain outside scope.
